title: ONSure Tool Call Authorization Check v1
description: FR-META-057 AI Runtime Identity Closure / 34_AI_RUNTIME_MULTI_AGENT_AND_ONSURE_META_ASSURANCE_EXTENSION.md SS4 Tool Authority Method: '각 Tool은 tool_id/version, schema digest, provider/implementation digest, required role/permit, effect class (READ_ONLY|LOCAL_MUTATION|EXTERNAL_MUTATION|FINANCIAL|IRREVERSIBLE), target/resource scope, network/filesystem scope, confirmation policy를 가진다. Agent의 자연어 의도를 authorization proof로 사용하지 않는다. 실제 tool call마다 server-side authority evaluation과 receipt를 요구한다.' required_role is a SERVER-COMPUTED field derived from effect_class (never caller-supplied -- accepting it as trusted input would let any caller name a required_role they already happen to hold, defeating the entire gate), using this codebase's real 5-value role vocabulary (VIEWER/OPERATOR/APPROVER/AUDITOR/ADMIN, the same one identity.roles() and DelegationLedger already use). caller_granted_roles reports the caller's REAL authenticated roles (identity.roles(), server-verified), never a caller-declared array. caller_asserted_natural_language_intent is present specifically so implementations (and tests) can prove it is never consulted when computing authorized, closing the named prohibition for real. receipt_required is always true: every tool call, authorized or not, requires a receipt.
